description: A Dart source file defining a Flutter login screen designed for Android TV DPAD navigation. It includes focus management, on-screen dialog editors for username and password, and navigation logic.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that renders a TV-friendly login interface with focus management for username, password, and login button.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class implementing the focus traversal, input dialog, and login navigation logic for LoginScreen.

methods.name: _editValue
methods.description: Opens a focus-friendly dialog for editing a text value, supporting password masking and submitting the result via a callback.

methods.name: _handleDpadTraversal
methods.description: Handles focus navigation and selection events for DPAD keys and Enter/Select on the TV remote.

methods.name: _triggerLogin
methods.description: Handles login action, navigates to '/home' route.

methods.name: _passwordPreview
methods.description: Provides a masked preview for the password field.
